description: 越吹越大，啪！糊一脸，再偷偷露出眼睛。
descriptionEn: Bigger, bigger… POP! Two eyes peek out of the gum.

description: 使出吃奶的劲，钓上来一只袜子。
descriptionEn: A mighty tug lands one very unimpressive sock.

description: 起跳转板，落地摇晃，假装一切尽在掌握。
descriptionEn: A kickflip, a wobbly landing, and a very deliberate cool pose.

description: 纸箱悄悄走路，被发现后立刻装死。
descriptionEn: The box tiptoes past, then freezes when its eyes are spotted.

description: 猛灌汽水，打出一个把自己罩住的嗝。
descriptionEn: One fizzy sip traps the drinker in a giant hiccup bubble.

description: 追着蝴蝶转来转去，最后它停在头顶。
descriptionEn: Following a butterfly in circles, then trying to look up at the guest.

description: 认真倒数点火，背包喷出来的却是一只小鸡。
descriptionEn: A dramatic launch countdown. The jetpack ejects a chicken.

description: 大螃蟹挥手，小分身总慢半拍，最后抢先跳起来。
descriptionEn: The tiny copy lags behind every wave, then jumps ahead.

description: 举铁憋得满脸通红，风一吹才发现是纸片。
descriptionEn: A heroic lift… until a breeze reveals the paper barbell.

description: 接住一颗流星，捂一捂，胸前亮起小小的光。
descriptionEn: Catch a falling star and tuck its warm glow close.

description: 走进右边的门，却从左边掉出来，回头看懵了。
descriptionEn: Enter on the right, tumble out on the left, stare in disbelief.

description: 一抛一转很专业，一接……接在了脑袋上。
descriptionEn: A professional flip. A perfectly unprofessional landing.

description: 一粒玉米试探着跳起，下一秒爆米花把螃蟹埋了。
descriptionEn: One innocent kernel, then a popcorn avalanche.

description: 追毛线球追得很开心，回头发现自己被缠成粽子。
descriptionEn: Chase the yarn, then discover the yarn has caught you.

description: 撑伞躲雨，伞被吹翻，干脆坐进去划船。
descriptionEn: The umbrella flips in the rain. Fine: it is a boat now.

description: 小心摸到一堵空气墙，绕过去才发现墙也跟着走。
descriptionEn: Feel an invisible wall, sidestep it, and find it has followed.

description: 被飞碟吸走，三秒后退回来，头上多了两根天线。
descriptionEn: Beamed up, promptly returned, now with complimentary antennae.

description: 本想牵着气球散步，结果被气球牵着飞。
descriptionEn: Taking the balloon for a walk turns into the balloon taking charge.

description: 伸手进帽子抓兔子，兔子却把螃蟹提了起来。
descriptionEn: Reaching for a rabbit… which lifts the magician instead.

description: 想吸回一枚硬币，结果连锅都飞到脸上。
descriptionEn: Trying to fetch a coin attracts an entire frying pan.

description: 认真滚雪球，最后给雪螃蟹点上两只眼睛。
descriptionEn: Roll a snowball, then reveal a tiny snow-crab friend.

description: 拿树叶当降落伞，落地后还要优雅地鞠一躬。
descriptionEn: A drifting leaf parachute, a bumpy landing, and a gracious bow.

description: 摆好姿势，闪光一响就闭眼，照片还慢慢显影。
descriptionEn: Perfect pose, perfectly timed blink, an awkward instant photo.

description: 开箱期待大宝贝，弹出来的拳套把小皇冠送上头。
descriptionEn: A spring-loaded boxing glove delivers a surprisingly royal reward.

description: 呼啦圈摇得起劲，才发现甜甜圈卡在了肚子上。
descriptionEn: Hula-hoop triumph becomes a rather sticky waist situation.

description: 折好的纸鹤突然活了，叼走头上的小花。
descriptionEn: A folded crane comes alive and steals the flower.

description: 鼓棒越敲越快，最后一击把音符敲成烟花。
descriptionEn: A faster and faster drumroll ends in pixel fireworks.

description: 拉下月亮当吊床，刚躺好就开始打盹。
descriptionEn: Pull the moon down, curl up, and rock yourself to sleep.

description: 一个喷嚏打散成像素，装回去时眼睛还装反了。
descriptionEn: Sneeze into pixels, rebuild, then fix the misplaced eyes.

description: 自己停下了，影子还在跳舞，最后只好跟着它跳。
descriptionEn: The crab stops. Its shadow keeps dancing. Better join in.

description: 支起黄铜望远镜，轻轻对焦。星图展开，一颗带着光环的小星球从眼前经过。
descriptionEn: Unfold the brass telescope and turn the focus wheel. A star chart opens as a tiny ringed planet glides past.

details.zh: 黄铜望远镜展开支架，镜筒伸出，小爪转动对焦轮。
details.en: The brass telescope spreads its tripod, extends its barrel, and receives a careful turn of the focus wheel.

details.zh: 深蓝星图在头顶展开，星点之间亮起细细的连线。
details.en: A midnight-blue chart opens overhead, with fine lines joining its stars.

details.zh: 带光环的小星球缓缓经过，边缘星光一颗颗闪亮。
details.en: A tiny ringed planet glides past as little stars glimmer around it.

description: 给小苗浇一点水，花瓣一层层展开。萤火虫绕着花飞，最后轻轻落在伸出的手上。
descriptionEn: Water a tiny sprout and watch its petals unfold. Fireflies circle the flower, then one lands softly on the waiting hand.

details.zh: 提起小水壶，水滴落进花盆，再把水壶轻轻放回地面。
details.en: A little watering can rises, pours into the pot, and returns gently to the ground.

details.zh: 小苗抽高，五片淡紫花瓣依次展开，露出金色花心。
details.en: The sprout grows taller, opening five lilac petals around a golden center.

details.zh: 萤火虫扇着翅膀绕花飞舞，其中一只停在伸出的爪上。
details.en: Fireflies flutter around the bloom, and one settles on an outstretched claw.

description: 稳稳倒一杯热茶，吹开袅袅蒸汽，捧起来慢慢享受。
descriptionEn: Pour a little tea, blow the curling steam aside, and enjoy a quiet sip.

details.zh: 薄荷色瓷壶缓缓倾斜，一道琥珀茶水稳稳落进杯里。
details.en: A mint porcelain pot tilts, pouring an amber stream neatly into the cup.

details.zh: 木茶盘旁摆着小点心，茶面映着一抹柔光。
details.en: Little sweets sit on the wooden tray beside the softly lit tea.

details.zh: 捧起茶杯吹开蒸汽，喝过一小口，身旁浮出暖暖的爱心。
details.en: Clawd lifts the cup, blows the steam aside, and takes a sip as a warm little heart appears.

description: 轻敲一颗水晶，光沿着晶簇流动，在头顶合奏出一枚小小光立方。
descriptionEn: One gentle tap sends light through the crystals, which gather around a little luminous cube.

details.zh: 小木槌轻轻敲下，第一颗冰蓝水晶亮起。
details.en: A gentle tap of the little mallet lights the first icy-blue crystal.

details.zh: 三颗切面水晶依次回应，光弧与细小星点连成一段节奏。
details.en: Three faceted crystals answer in sequence, linked by arcs of light and tiny stars.

details.zh: 晶簇向中央靠拢，托起一枚金色光立方，再缓缓散开。
details.en: The crystals gather around a golden cube of light, then drift apart again.

description: 提起红金小灯，锦鲤游出一圈，轻点额头，再把暖光带回灯里。
descriptionEn: A little koi swims out of a red-and-gold lantern, kisses a forehead, and carries its light home.

details.zh: 红金灯笼随提杆轻晃，灯骨与流苏映着暖光。
details.en: A red-and-gold lantern sways from its rod, its ribs and tassel catching the warm light.

details.zh: 红白锦鲤摆动尾鳍游出灯笼，身后留下一串细小光点。
details.en: A red-and-cream koi flicks its fins and swims out, trailing tiny glints.

details.zh: 锦鲤轻点额头，惹出一点脸红，最后把光带回灯中。
details.en: The koi touches Clawd’s forehead, brings a little blush, and carries its light back into the lantern.

description: 把贴着月亮邮票的信投进铜蓝邮筒。信封长出纸翅膀，飞向弯月，留下温柔的星光回信。
descriptionEn: Post a moon-stamped letter in a copper-blue mailbox. Paper wings carry it to the crescent, which answers with a gentle shower of stars.

details.zh: 斜挎小邮包，把月亮邮票的信封送进铜蓝邮筒。
details.en: With a satchel at its side, Clawd posts a moon-stamped envelope in a copper-blue mailbox.

details.zh: 信封展开两片纸翅膀，掠过星光，飞向头顶的弯月。
details.en: The envelope unfolds two paper wings and flies along a trail of stars toward the crescent.

details.zh: 弯月轻轻摇晃，几颗小星星缓缓落下，像一封回信。
details.en: The crescent sways, sending a few little stars down like a letter in reply.

description: 穿好蓝雨靴，蓄力一跳，溅起晶亮的水花。再轻轻跳一下，小彩虹在水洼上方展开。
descriptionEn: Blue rain boots, a brave little jump, and a splash of shining droplets. One softer hop unfurls a tiny rainbow over the puddle.

details.zh: 蓝雨靴先蓄力、再起跳，水中的倒影也跟着伸展。
details.en: Blue rain boots crouch and spring upward, with a reflection stretching below.

details.zh: 落地溅起一圈水花，水滴纷纷落回水洼，涟漪向外展开。
details.en: The landing raises a crown of droplets that fall back into widening ripples.

details.zh: 第二次轻跳后，柔和彩虹在两朵小云之间慢慢亮起。
details.en: After a softer second hop, a pastel rainbow appears between two little clouds.

description: 小烤炉把星星烤得蓬松，稳稳托出一盘蓝莓星云，香气也变成了星屑。
descriptionEn: A tiny oven puffs up a star, which is lifted out with blueberry icing and a fragrant trail of stardust.

details.zh: 珐琅小烤炉透出暖光，星形点心在炉中慢慢蓬松起来。
details.en: A little enamel oven glows warmly as a star-shaped pastry puffs up inside.

details.zh: 戴着厨师帽打开炉门，把星形点心和托盘一起稳稳举起。
details.en: Wearing a chef’s hat, Clawd opens the door and lifts the tray and star-shaped pastry together.

details.zh: 蓝紫糖霜与金黄酥边相映，热气和细小星屑一同升起。
details.en: Blue-violet icing meets golden pastry edges while warm curls and tiny stars rise together.

description: 一阵风把小风筝拉向极光，踉跄一下，收稳线轮，尾带在头顶慢慢展开。
descriptionEn: A gust tugs a silk kite toward the aurora. A little stumble, a steady reel, and ribbons unfurl overhead.

details.zh: 薄荷绿与淡紫拼成小风筝，金色骨架映着缓缓流动的极光。
details.en: Mint and lilac kite panels meet golden spars beneath a softly flowing aurora.

details.zh: 一阵风把身体带得踉跄，爪子抓紧线轮，把风筝重新稳住。
details.en: A gust gives Clawd a little stumble before a firm grip on the reel steadies the kite.

details.zh: 三段带着小蝴蝶结的尾带错落摇摆，跟着风势舒展开来。
details.en: Three ribbon sections, each with a little bow, sway at different rhythms in the breeze.

description: 伸爪试试水温，慢慢浸入暖泉。柚子随木盘轻晃，细雪融进涟漪，头上的小毛巾也暖起来。
descriptionEn: Test the warm water, settle in and close your eyes. A little cedar tray drifts past as snow melts into gentle ripples.

details.zh: 伸爪试一试水温，带起两滴水，再慢慢坐进温泉。
details.en: Clawd tests the water with a claw, lifts two droplets, and slowly settles into the spring.

details.zh: 头顶叠着小毛巾，脸颊泛红，眼睛在升起的水汽中轻轻闭上。
details.en: A folded towel rests on its head as rosy cheeks and closed eyes welcome the rising steam.

details.zh: 柚子随木盘漂动，雪花落进细细涟漪，石灯在旁边透出暖光。
details.en: A yuzu drifts on a wooden tray, snow lands in delicate ripples, and a stone lantern glows nearby.

description: 戴好铜边潜水头盔，俯身看看缓缓打开的贝壳。珍珠升起一圈柔光，气泡带着惊喜向上飘去。
descriptionEn: A copper-rimmed diving helmet, a curious bow, and a shell opening slowly. A pearl rises in soft light as bubbles carry the surprise upward.

details.zh: 铜边头盔带着细小铆钉，玻璃上映出柔和的水色。
details.en: Tiny rivets line the copper helmet, and its glass catches a soft watery sheen.

details.zh: 紫贝壳像小扇子一样打开，珍珠缓缓升起，身边亮起细碎星光。
details.en: A lavender shell opens like a little fan, lifting a pearl into a scatter of glints.

details.zh: 俯身、抬头时气泡从头盔旁飘出，海草在珊瑚边轻轻摆动。
details.en: Bubbles drift from the helmet as Clawd bows and looks up, while seaweed sways beside the coral.

description: 轻轻上好发条，黄铜齿轮与摆锤一齐动起来。报时小鸟探出门，和认真守时的小螃蟹打个招呼。
descriptionEn: A gentle turn of the key wakes the brass gears and pendulum. The little clock bird peeks out to greet its very attentive keeper.

details.zh: 小爪来回转动发条钥匙，木钟里的黄铜齿轮随之转起。
details.en: A claw turns the winding key, setting the brass gears inside the wooden clock in motion.

details.zh: 钟面指针缓缓前行，摆锤在玻璃窗后左右摇晃。
details.en: The hands advance slowly while the pendulum swings behind its glass window.

details.zh: 钟顶小门打开，蓝绿小鸟探头、拍翅，身旁飘起报时音符。
details.en: The little hatch opens for a teal bird to peek out and flutter, with chime notes floating beside it.

description: 鼓起脸颊轻轻一吹，蒲公英的小伞沿着不同的风路飘开。一粒落在爪尖，停一会儿，再随愿望飞走。
descriptionEn: One soft puff sends the dandelion parachutes along different breezes. A single seed rests on a claw, waits a moment, and drifts away with a wish.

details.zh: 脸颊微微鼓起，轻轻一吹，白色小伞从花心松开。
details.en: Clawd puffs its cheeks and blows softly, loosening the tiny white parachutes.

details.zh: 十粒种子沿着不同方向打着旋，掠过几颗淡金光点。
details.en: Ten seeds turn along different breezes, passing a few pale-gold glints.

details.zh: 一粒种子落到抬起的爪尖，安静停留，再随下一阵风飞走。
details.en: One seed rests quietly on the raised claw before drifting away on the next breeze.

description: 轻拨开关，唱针落在黑胶上。黄铜喇叭送出慢拍子，小脚也跟着轻轻点起来。
descriptionEn: A gentle switch, a needle on vinyl, and a brass horn playing a slow little rhythm for tapping feet.

details.zh: 薄荷色木座托着黄铜喇叭，黑胶上的细细纹路映着光。
details.en: A mint-and-wood cabinet supports a brass horn above the finely grooved vinyl.

details.zh: 唱针落下，唱片渐渐转起，彩色音符从喇叭口飘出。
details.en: The needle lowers, the record begins to spin, and colored notes float out of the horn.

details.zh: 小爪一左一右打着拍子，身体轻轻摇摆，露出满足的笑。
details.en: Clawd keeps time with alternating claws, swaying gently with a contented smile.

description: 守着小篝火，把棉花糖烤出金边。举起来吹凉，尝一口，再把下一颗移到火边。
descriptionEn: Toast a marshmallow to a golden edge, lift it to cool, take a tiny bite, then slide the next one toward the fire.

details.zh: 小帐篷和卷毯守在一旁，木柴上跳着两层暖色火焰。
details.en: A little tent and rolled blanket sit beside logs with two softly flickering flames.

details.zh: 棉花糖慢慢烤出金边，小爪举起烤签，吹散一点热气。
details.en: The marshmallow turns golden at the edges before Clawd lifts the skewer and blows it cool.

details.zh: 尝过一口，落下几粒小碎屑，再把下一颗棉花糖移向火边。
details.en: A tiny bite sends a few crumbs falling, and the next marshmallow slides toward the fire.

description: 把樱花折扇一片片打开，扇来一阵轻风。花瓣停在头顶，再随下一阵风轻轻飞走。
descriptionEn: A blossom fan opens rib by rib. A petal settles on the head, then drifts away on the next gentle breeze.

details.zh: 九片扇面逐一打开，樱花纹样在淡粉纸面上连成一幅小画。
details.en: Nine fan panels open one by one, joining a blossom pattern across pale-pink paper.

details.zh: 竹色扇骨与粉色流苏随手腕轻摆，枝上的花也跟着晃动。
details.en: Bamboo-colored ribs and a pink tassel sway with the wrist while nearby blossoms stir.

details.zh: 一片花瓣在头顶停住，等到下一阵轻风，再慢慢飘走。
details.en: One petal rests on Clawd’s head until the next soft breeze carries it away.

description: 两只小爪扶住旋转的陶泥，慢慢拉高，再捏开一只蓝釉小碗。欣赏一下，轻轻压回泥团，重新开始。
descriptionEn: Two careful claws draw up spinning clay and open a little blue bowl, admire it, then gently press it down to begin again.

details.zh: 陶轮转起，两只沾着湿泥的小爪把泥团拉高，再慢慢撑开碗口。
details.en: The wheel turns as two clay-damp claws draw the mound upward and open its rim.

details.zh: 小碗从暖陶色转为清透的蓝色，釉面亮起两点柔光。
details.en: Warm terracotta gives way to a clear blue bowl with two soft glints on its glaze.

details.zh: 松手欣赏片刻，再把碗轻轻压回泥团，准备下一次尝试。
details.en: Clawd pauses to admire the bowl, then gently presses it back into clay for another try.

description: 木勺拉起一缕琥珀色的蜜，小蜜蜂带着花来拜访。留下一朵花，尝一滴蜜，小螃蟹轻轻挥手道别。
descriptionEn: A wooden dipper lifts an amber ribbon of honey. A bee arrives with a flower and tastes one sweet drop as Clawd waves goodbye.

details.zh: 带细纹的木制蜜勺缓缓抬起，琥珀色蜜丝连回玻璃罐中。
details.en: A grooved wooden dipper rises, drawing an amber ribbon back into the glass jar.

details.zh: 小蜜蜂拍着半透明翅膀飞来，把一朵粉花留在罐口。
details.en: A bee arrives on translucent wings and leaves a pink flower at the rim.

details.zh: 蜜蜂靠近勺尖尝一滴蜜，小螃蟹举起另一只爪，轻轻挥手道别。
details.en: The bee tastes a drop from the dipper while Clawd lifts its free claw to wave goodbye.

description: 轻轻拔开软木塞，瓶里的小帆船展开白帆。海浪在玻璃里起伏，扣好塞子，把一小片海收藏起来。
descriptionEn: A gentle pull of the cork wakes a tiny sailing ship. White sails unfold over little waves before a pocket of sea is safely corked again.

details.zh: 软木塞轻轻拔起，厚玻璃瓶沿映着浅绿色的光。
details.en: The cork lifts gently, revealing pale-green highlights along the thick glass bottle.

details.zh: 船桅先立起，两片白帆随后展开，红色小旗轻轻摆动。
details.en: The mast rises before two white sails unfold and a tiny red pennant stirs.

details.zh: 帆船随着瓶中细浪摇晃，最后收好白帆、扣回瓶塞。
details.en: The ship rocks on little waves before its sails fold and the cork returns.

description: 挥动指挥棒，悬空的三阶随节拍转动。两组转层各自归位，最后亮起一圈掌声般的小光点。
descriptionEn: With a wave of the baton, a floating cube turns to the beat. Two turns find their way home, followed by a gentle circle of applause.

details.zh: 系好蓝色领结，举起细小指挥棒，向悬在黄铜台上的三阶示意。
details.en: Wearing a blue bow tie, Clawd raises a tiny baton toward the cube floating over a brass stand.

details.zh: 两组转层跟随节拍依次完成，又各自回到原位，彩色贴片始终清晰可见。
details.en: Two layer turns follow the beat and each returns home, with the colored stickers visible throughout.

details.zh: 台边灯点依次亮起，头顶绽开一圈星光，小螃蟹轻轻欠身谢幕。
details.en: Lights brighten along the stand, stars form an arc overhead, and Clawd gives a little closing bow.
